supplements.name: Evening supplement
supplements.conditions: The source agreement may apply this addition between 18:00 and 23:00 when the work is not treated as regular shift work. Confirm current hours and conditions from the original source.

supplements.name: Night supplement
supplements.conditions: The source agreement may apply this addition between 23:00 and 06:00 when the work is not treated as regular shift work. Confirm current hours and conditions from the original source.

supplements.name: Selected Saturday compensation
supplements.calculation_rule: 50% increased pay on certain Saturdays named in the source agreement.
supplements.conditions: This is not a Saturday rate for every week. Confirm the named days from the original source.

supplements.name: Specified public-holiday and eve compensation
supplements.calculation_rule: 100% increased pay on specified public-holiday and eve dates named in the source agreement, including Midsummer Eve, Christmas Eve, May Day and Independence Day.
supplements.conditions: Applies only to the days named in the source agreement. Confirm the exact day and working-time arrangement from the original source.

publication_rule: A supplement requires its own applicability, validity, source and verification status. No supplement is inherited across sectors, and no rate is assumed.
